How projects were classified

From each repository's history: how many commits were made before 2026, how many were landed by the agent fleet (its commits are authored as Cacophony Daemon), co-author trailers naming an AI model, and when agent instruction files first appeared. The author then checked every label, and the author's call stands where the numbers are close.

The labels describe the code, not the sites themselves, which were all written by agents.
